published_facts.statement: NIST gives a Type T thermocouple comparison example using a stirred bath and platinum resistance reference.
Section 3.4 gives an illustrative 100 mV DVM range tolerance of 4 ppm of reading plus 0.3 microvolt; this is not an owned-instrument specification.
NIST lists IPRT calibration U(k=2)=2.4 mK from 0.5 to 95 degrees Celsius; digital-readout uncertainty is excluded.
Dataset material is nominally 6 mm black cast PMMA, identified as ACRYLITE cast black 9H01 GT.
External NIST radiant gasification data concern approximately 70 mm PMMA discs, with Type K back-surface thermocouples and a preliminary-release label.
SRD 60 provides ITS-90 thermocouple EMF/temperature tables; it is not a calibration certificate for an individual sensor.

measurand.target: one-second mean temperature at instrumented coupon midplane centre; finite probe sensing volumes require justified spatial transfer
measurand.temporal_support_requirement: Document matching integration windows or a qualified averaging procedure, including aperture, filter settings, window start/end and timestamp convention. A 1 Hz cadence alone does not establish a one-second mean. Revise the declared temporal measurand before acquisition if it cannot be supported.

specimen.candidate_grade: ACRYLITE cast black 9H01 GT if obtainable; substitution separately identified
specimen.conditioning_and_history: to be recorded from actual material; envelope and material-state review required

reference_chain.static: calibrated four-wire PRT with independent resistance readout in stirred bath

installation.candidate: parallel bores reaching midplane; thermocouple and miniature PRT
installation.requirement: drawing and sacrificial-coupon inspection before dynamic use

design_assumptions.cooling: monitored return to 25 degrees Celsius; no cooling-rate performance claim

development_screen.allocation: one independent specimen per rate per day
development_screen.confirmatory_rule: choose after variance/precision analysis; freeze before new specimens and held-out day are opened

net_sample_selection.selection: predeclare phase-fraction instants and snap to actual synchronized acquisition indices with frozen rule; record indices and timing uncertainty
net_sample_selection.windowing: additional predeclared windows remain separate comparisons; all windows retained

conversion.thermocouple: separately qualified nonlinear voltage/reference-junction conversion using bound Type T reference function plus individual calibration
conversion.net_affine_role: only a justified residual affine correction after validated conversion to K, or a separately qualified narrow affine approximation

public_datasets.use: external-data importer, missingness and provenance exercises; not physical validation of proposed chain

files.required_import_handling: preserve missingness as explicit null/invalid; never zero or fabricated uncertainty

evidence_gaps: Actual sensor/readout/clock/material identities and operator-approved installation envelope.
Calibration certificates, validity, individual conversion functions and readout uncertainty.
Miniature dynamic-reference availability, calibration, fit and probe perturbation assessment.
Installation and timing transfer from distinct probe locations to the same target; no label-only mapping.
Complete uncertainty budgets and joint covariance, with reference/fit/common-error double counting excluded.
Raw/reference measurements and timing characterization; none supplied.
Frozen stability, missing/saturation, source-selection and held-out confirmation criteria.
Independent-cycle precision/sample-size rationale and confirmatory results.
Nonlinear conversion and installation-transfer software qualification; existing affine operation is insufficient.
Physical qualification review; no SP1 proof or numerical PASS substitutes for this evidence.
